design.decision: Pick the one card to pass: void a singleton for ruffing, or hand off the one honor that would break a nil.
design.opponent: Revealed at Opening; opponents get little information from a single swap.
design.rationale: Near-duplicate of seed-swap by count; together with cc-swap-five it brackets the flat three-card seed (-0.3) so the slope of swap size can be read, and one precise card is the simplest enabler in the pool.
